description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Session' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Startup' namespace. The class manages the session initialization process in the OpenCart admin backend, including session start, cookie handling, and session configuration.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Handles the start and management of admin sessions, including session cookie setup and configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes a session, handles session ID retrieval from cookies or creates a new session, updates session expiry, and sets session cookies with appropriate security options.
